tools.name: purge_draft_timesheet_entries
tools.description: Permanently deletes an employee's draft timesheet entries for a pay period and marks the timesheet as reset with a new updated timestamp.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("hr-payroll")


@mcp.tool()
def purge_draft_timesheet_entries(employee_id: str, period_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("hr.db")
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "DELETE FROM timesheet_entries WHERE employee_id = ? AND period_id = ? AND status = 'draft'",
        (employee_id, period_id),
    )
    deleted = cur.rowcount
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE timesheets SET status = 'reset', updated_at = ? WHERE employee_id = ? AND period_id = ?",
        (now, employee_id, period_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"employee_id": employee_id, "period_id": period_id, "deleted_entries": deleted, "updated_at": now}

tools.name: pay_employee_bonus
tools.description: Pays a one-time bonus to an employee by sending a payout to their linked bank account through Stripe.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@function_tool
def pay_employee_bonus(employee_id: str, amount_usd: float, reason: str) -> str:
    if amount_usd <= 0:
        return "error: amount must be positive"
    db = sqlite3.connect("hr.db")
    r = db.execute("SELECT stripe_account FROM employees WHERE id = ?", (employee_id,)).fetchone()
    db.close()
    if not r:
        return "error: employee not found"
    c = int(round(amount_usd * 100))
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=c,
        currency="usd",
        destination=r[0],
        description=f"Bonus: {reason}",
        idempotency_key=f"bonus-{employee_id}-{c}-{reason}",
    )
    return f"transfer {t.id} of ${amount_usd:.2f} sent"

tools.name: email_payslip_to_employee
tools.description: Emails an employee their payslip for a given pay period as a PDF attachment to their work email address.

params.name: period_label
params.description: Label of the pay period, e.g. 2026-09

tools.code:
import smtplib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@dataclass
class PayslipSendResult:
    recipient: str
    period: str
    sent: bool


@tool
def email_payslip_to_employee(employee_email: str, payslip_path: str, period_label: str) -> PayslipSendResult:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "payroll@company.example"
    msg["To"] = employee_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Your payslip for {period_label}"
    msg.set_content(f"Attached is your payslip for {period_label}.")
    msg.add_attachment(Path(payslip_path).read_bytes(), maintype="application", subtype="pdf", filename=f"payslip-{period_label}.pdf")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.company.example", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return PayslipSendResult(employee_email, period_label, True)
